scope: Diagnostics-only delta for the disposable admin reset runner

verdict_a.title: Diagnostic sufficiency and runtime status
verdict_a.evidence: The diagnostic is emitted only after the second native reset-action click throws. It records fixed failure categories and bounded DOM facts, without changing the native click or the post-confirm storage/sign-out oracle. It can help distinguish absent/layout, hit-test obstruction, dialog/inert/animation, viewport, and input-dispatch boundaries.

finding.detail: target_count counts every exact-text button, including hidden or inert duplicates; settings-panel-driver.click filters candidates for visibility and inert ancestry before enforcing uniqueness. A hidden duplicate can therefore report target_count > 1 even when the native click sees one eligible target. The diagnostic also hit-tests only the first raw match, making that result ambiguous when duplicates exist.
finding.recommendation: Make the diagnostic count and hit-test the same eligible visible candidates as the click driver's uniqueness check, while retaining only booleans/counts in the receipt.

verdict_a.limitations: The recorded isolated-admin-reset-001/002 failures show the runner stopped before Confirm; they do not establish a product reset defect. No browser/runtime execution was performed for this review.

verdict_b.title: Safety and source quality
verdict_b.evidence: Only a fixed category, booleans, and counts are persisted. Raw exception text is consulted only for prefix classification and is not returned or written. Snapshot failure emits a fixed availability boolean. Native click sequence and acceptance assertions are unchanged; diagnostic evaluation is read-only.

next_action: Correct the visible-candidate mismatch before relying on target_count as root-cause evidence; then the root-owned guarded run can collect runtime evidence.
